name: ProdvanceAI – Modern Advanced AI Product Search for WooCommerce
author: TeamMWS

sections.description:
ProdvanceAI – Modern Advanced AI Product Search for WooCommerce upgrades your store’s search experience using Artificial Intelligence and an optimized Product Index Table for high-performance results.

Your customers can search instantly across all product fields — title, SKU, category, brand, attributes, or even unique identifiers like GTIN and EAN — with live AJAX results, typo correction, and smart ranking.

Whether your store has 100 or 100,000+ products, ProdvanceAI ensures accurate, relevant, and ultra-fast search performance — fully compatible with all major page builders and themes.

🔖 Shortcodes

✅ [mpsfw_search_form] — Display the AI-powered product search form anywhere (pages, widgets, builders).

⚙️ Product Index Table Technology

✅ Dedicated Index Table – All product data stored in a high-performance index table for instant lookup.
✅ Auto Sync – Automatically updates when products are added, edited, or deleted.
✅ Smart Relevance Engine – Prioritizes titles, SKUs, and categories for the most accurate results.
✅ Scalable Architecture – Optimized for WooCommerce stores of all sizes.
✅ Rebuild Option – Regenerate the index manually anytime from settings.
✅ Blazing Fast Queries – Near-instant response times even on large product catalogs.

⚡ Main Features

🔍 Search In Any Product Field

✅ Search inside title, description, short description
✅ Search by SKU, ID, categories, tags, and brands
✅ Includes GTIN, UPC, EAN, ISBN unique codes
✅ Works with custom fields, attributes, and taxonomies
✅ Full variable product and attribute-based search support

🤖 AI-Powered Search Engine

✅ Intelligent context-based ranking
✅ Fuzzy logic to fix spelling mistakes (e.g., “laptot” → “laptop”)
✅ Detects plural/singular variations automatically
✅ Synonym support – equates similar terms (e.g., “sneaker” = “shoe”)
✅ Stop word filtering for cleaner results
✅ Supports AND/OR search logic (Pro version)

⚙️ Live Ajax Search

✅ Instant results as users type
✅ Display product image, price, and short description
✅ Fully responsive design optimized for all devices
✅ Lightweight and ultra-fast – no page reloads

🧩 Page Builder Integration

✅ Elementor Widget included
✅ Compatible with Gutenberg, Divi, WPBakery, Bricks, Oxygen, Flatsome UX, Avada, and more

🧠 Smart Ranking System

✅ Field-based weight scoring (title > tags > description)
✅ Results sorted by relevance
✅ Built-in cache system for faster repeat searches
✅ Automatic index rebuilds ensure data freshness

💡 User Experience Enhancements

✅ Highlights matched keywords in results
✅ Option to set maximum number of results
✅ Replace default WooCommerce search seamlessly
✅ Full mobile layout support

📊 Analytics & Tracking

✅ Google Analytics integration – track all user searches
✅ Analyze most searched products for store insights

🧱 Admin Controls

✅ Clean and intuitive settings panel
✅ Manual index rebuild control
✅ Choose visible product data (image, title, price, SKU, etc.)
✅ Developer-friendly structure for customization

🌐 Multilingual Compatibility

✅ Works with WPML, Polylang, WooCommerce Multilingual, qTranslate, and GTranslate

🧠 Why Choose ProdvanceAI

✅ Powered by AI + Product Index Table
✅ Faster than default WooCommerce search
✅ Accurate and context-aware results
✅ Works with Elementor & major page builders
✅ Designed for both performance and scalability
✅ Lightweight, responsive, and fully customizable

📦 Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ProdvanceAI settings to configure search options.
  4. Add the shortcode or Elementor widget anywhere on your site.

🧰 Upgrade Notice

= 1.0.3 =
🎉 Big update! Introducing ProdvanceAI Core Engine v2 – experience faster, smarter, and more accurate product searches.
We recommend updating to this version for the best AI performance and compatibility with the latest WooCommerce and Elementor versions.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin replace the default WooCommerce search?

Yes ✅ ProdvanceAI automatically enhances or replaces the default WooCommerce product search with an intelligent AI-powered version.

How does the Product Index Table work?

The plugin builds a custom index table that stores product titles, SKUs, categories, and meta data. This allows lightning-fast searches — even on stores with thousands of products.

Will this slow down my website?

No 🚀 — the index table and caching ensure search queries are handled instantly with minimal server load.

Can I use it with Elementor or Divi?

Absolutely ✅ — it includes a dedicated Elementor Widget and is fully compatible with Divi, WPBakery, Oxygen, and other major builders.

How can I show the search bar on my page?

Use the shortcode [mpsfw_search_form] anywhere in your post, page, or widget area.

Do I need to rebuild the index manually?

No. The plugin automatically updates the index when products are added, updated, or deleted. You can manually rebuild it anytime from the settings page.

Does it support multilingual websites?

Yes 🌐 It works seamlessly with WPML, Polylang, and other multilingual plugins.

Is it compatible with large WooCommerce stores?

Yes 💪 Designed with performance in mind, it can easily handle stores with 100,000+ products.

– Added Elementor widget for drag-and-drop AI search integration

  • Minor performance and UI enhancements.

  • Improved fuzzy search, synonyms, and typo correction.
